deduplicated_scenarios.policy: Identity is method + path_template + scenario name. Latest recorded HTTP attempt in main/resume/extra order determines the final local outcome; all historical HTTP failures and no-HTTP harness attempts remain in the original results and per-attempt report. Repeated successful attempts count once. No HTTP outcome establishes appliance completion.

coverage_boundaries.scope: Nine directly affected encryption-key endpoints; shared task service behavior also exercised by focused automated tests. Other feature write endpoints were not dispatched through Swagger.
controlled_dependencies: Synthetic local PostgreSQL accounts/users/roles/resources/tasks with actual stored permission strings
JWTs signed using running local API settings; tokens retained only in memory
Per-test-account Redis feature flag and account-license values; this does not validate PostHog or NOC licensing
Supplemental dispatch failures use a deliberately invalid cached public key on fresh fake appliance GUIDs, before transport publication
pending_real_filer: Successful delivery and completion of write commands on 10.84.2.115
Permission for real filer writes/passphrase changes remains unanswered
Current container AWS session is invalid for NOC lookup/dispatch; development credentials need refresh
automated_only: Escrow-passphrase dispatch-failure handling: live tests cover readiness and recipient validation only; a failure after recipient validation could not be forced safely without risking real transport
Task failure-persistence exception fallback and cancellation handling
Serialization/transmission/message-storage error variants beyond the controlled live PGP failure
PostgreSQL concurrent terminal writers, rollback, and row-lock contention using temporary integration databases
not_exercised: Real IdP login/token issuance and production licensing services
Download artifact retrieval at the advertised status URL: implementation remains deferred by PORTAL-3190
